item.title: UPDATE – TRAFFIC SWAP: LA 511 (Jimmie Davis Bridge) replacement project, Bossier Parish
item.description: DOTD advises motorists that the below referenced traffic swap on Jimmie Davis Bridge has been rescheduled to begin on Friday, December 19, 2025. All other details related to the original announcement remain the same. DOTD appreciates your patience and understanding.
